fdroid:de.schliweb.moveapiece.name: MoveAPiece: Offline Chess
fdroid:de.schliweb.moveapiece.summary: Offline chess vs Stockfish or Maia, opening trainer, Pegasus & Chessnut boards
fdroid:de.schliweb.moveapiece.description:
Open it and play. MoveAPiece is an offline chess app that starts straight into a game against the Stockfish chess engine. No account, no ads, no internet connection, no settings screen. One "New Game" dialog covers every choice there is (opponent, colour, strength, opening), and the app remembers it for next time.
PLAY CHESS AGAINST THE COMPUTER
• Stockfish, the well-known open-source chess engine, at an adjustable playing strength from Elo 1320 to 3190, from beginner to master level
• Maia, a human-like chess AI: it plays the moves a player of a chosen rating (800 to 2400) would typically play, with natural thinking pauses. An opponent that feels like a club player, not a calculator
• Two players on one phone or tablet
• Chess960 (Fischer Random): every game starts from one of the 960 starting positions, picked at random, against Stockfish, Maia or a friend, on the screen or on an electronic board
LEARN CHESS OPENINGS
• Opening trainer with 20 well-known lines, among them Ruy Lopez, Sicilian Najdorf, Italian Game, Queen's Gambit, Caro-Kann and King's Indian. The app plays the book side and accepts only the correct reply
• Step-through opening library to review every line move by move
• Optional move hints while you learn
SOLVE TACTICS PUZZLES
• About 4,600 puzzles from real games, from the free Lichess puzzle database
• Picked to match your level: your puzzle rating adjusts after every puzzle, and you can make them easier or harder
• A hint or the whole solution when you are stuck
• Practise the mistakes of your own games: after the analysis, each one comes back as a puzzle
IMPROVE YOUR GAME
• Hint button, optional live evaluation, blunder warning after a bad move
• Post-game analysis that grades every move
• Undo, redo, flip the board, tap any move in the move list to jump there
• PGN import and export to study or share your games
ELECTRONIC CHESS BOARDS
Own a DGT Pegasus or a Chessnut Air, Air+, Pro or Go? Connect it over Bluetooth and play on the real board instead of the screen. Your moves are picked up from the pieces, the opponent's replies light up on the board's LEDs, and the app detects the board type on its own. The screen stays usable at the same time, for hints, evaluation and the move list.
OFFLINE AND PRIVATE
• Works completely offline, nothing leaves your device
• No account, no ads, no tracking, no in-app purchases
• Maia's neural network is bundled and runs on the device
• Free and open source (GPLv3)
Also there: move, capture and check sounds; portrait and landscape; phone and tablet layouts; English, German, French, Spanish, Italian and Dutch.

firefox-addons:2785747.description:
Google Translate
Google Translate Assistant is a professional translation extension that perfectly fixes the full-page translation problem of Google Chrome. It also supports word translation during web browsing, providing a convenient translation portal.
Google Translate will no longer provide services to mainland China at the end of September 2022. Users in China will not be able to use the browser web translation function normally. Google Translate Assistant supports Chrome-based browsers, as well as edge and Firefox browsers. The translator assists users in quickly reading foreign documents and improves the translation browsing experience.
★Full page translation
Right-click on a blank space on the web page and select "Translate the entire page into Chinese (Simplified)" to complete the full-text translation. It is applicable to all Google-based browsers. It also provides automatic full-page translation function to remember your full-page translation habits.
★Dictionary translation
When you encounter unfamiliar foreign language vocabulary while browsing, select it with your mouse for one-click translation, and the translation results will appear near the mouse. If you turn on the "Quick Word Translation" button, the mouse selection will immediately translate for you.
★Text translation
At the entrance of the extension, enter the text you want to translate and you will get the translation result immediately. It supports translation between hundreds of languages, supports automatic detection of the language you entered, and keeps the translation history for you, which can be retrieved at any time.
★Screenshot translation
When you encounter text that cannot be selected, take a screenshot of the area that needs to be translated and it can be translated into the language you want.
★Translate pronunciation
Provide pronunciation function for your translation results to break through pronunciation barriers.
★Shortcut keys
The extension provides shortcut keys for each translation function
Activate the extension (open the ‘Online Translation’ panel)：Alt+H
Screenshot translation：Alt+G
Webpage translation: Alt+T

firefox-addons:3060925.name: Password Reveal Blocker
firefox-addons:3060925.summary: Prevents passwords from being displayed in plain text on web pages, blocks “eye” reveal buttons, restores password fields that are changed to text, remains compatible with password managers, and supports centrally managed enterprise deployments.
firefox-addons:3060925.description:
Password Reveal Blocker - GoToDev est une extension de sécurité conçue pour renforcer la protection des mots de passe affichés dans les pages web.
Elle empêche lePassword Reveal Blocker - GoToDev is a security extension designed to strengthen the protection of passwords displayed on web pages.
It prevents “Show password” features or buttons represented by an eye icon from revealing the contents of password fields in plain text. When a protected field is changed from password to text, the extension detects the change and automatically restores the protected password mode.
Protection also relies on identifying common password-field markers, such as autocomplete="current-password", autocomplete="new-password", and other attributes commonly associated with password fields. An integrity-check mechanism regularly verifies that previously identified password fields remain protected.
The extension is designed to work alongside major password managers. It does not block their autofill mechanisms and does not access password values in order to provide its protection.
Password-protected administrator access is available for managing the extension settings. Protection can be temporarily suspended for 30 seconds, 1 minute, 2 minutes, or 5 minutes before being automatically re-enabled.
Password Reveal Blocker - GoToDev also includes an enterprise mode designed for organizations and IT departments. Settings can be centrally managed using Firefox Enterprise mechanisms, the Windows Registry, Group Policy (GPO), or deployment scripts.
In managed environments, IT administrators can define a shared administrator password, control whether temporary suspension is allowed, and combine the extension with Firefox policies that enforce installation and prevent users from disabling or removing it.
The extension operates entirely locally within Firefox. No passwords, browsing history, form contents, personal data, usage statistics, or telemetry are sent to GoToDev or any third-party service.
Password Reveal Blocker - GoToDev is intended as an additional defense-in-depth security measure alongside password managers and browser security policies. It does not claim to provide absolute protection against users with elevated system privileges or unrestricted access to debugging tools.s fonctions « Afficher le mot de passe » ou les boutons représentés par une icône en forme d’œil de révéler en clair le contenu d’un champ de mot de passe. Lorsqu’un champ protégé est transformé de password vers text, l’extension détecte la modification et restaure automatiquement le mode protégé.
La protection repose également sur l’identification de marqueurs caractéristiques des champs de mot de passe, tels que autocomplete="current-password", autocomplete="new-password" ou les attributs couramment associés aux mots de passe. Un mécanisme de contrôle d’intégrité vérifie régulièrement que les champs déjà identifiés restent protégés.
L’extension a été conçue pour fonctionner en complément des principaux gestionnaires de mots de passe. Elle ne bloque pas leur mécanisme de remplissage automatique et n’accède pas à la valeur des mots de passe pour assurer sa fonction.
Un accès administrateur protégé par mot de passe permet d’accéder aux paramètres de l’extension. La protection peut être suspendue temporairement pendant 30 secondes, 1 minute, 2 minutes ou 5 minutes avant sa réactivation automatique.
Password Reveal Blocker - GoToDev dispose également d’un mode entreprise destiné aux organisations et aux services informatiques. Les paramètres peuvent être administrés centralement à l’aide des mécanismes Firefox Enterprise, du registre Windows, de stratégies GPO ou de scripts de déploiement.
En environnement administré, la DSI peut notamment définir un mot de passe administrateur commun, contrôler les possibilités de suspension temporaire et associer l’extension aux politiques Firefox permettant de forcer son installation et d’empêcher sa désactivation ou sa suppression.
L’extension fonctionne entièrement localement dans Firefox. Aucun mot de passe, historique de navigation, contenu de formulaire, donnée personnelle, statistique d’utilisation ou télémétrie n’est envoyé à GoToDev ou à un service tiers.
Password Reveal Blocker - GoToDev constitue une mesure de défense en profondeur complémentaire à un gestionnaire de mots de passe et aux politiques de sécurité du navigateur. Elle ne prétend pas constituer à elle seule une protection absolue contre un utilisateur disposant de privilèges système élevés ou d’outils de débogage non restreints.

apple-itunes:1316632530.developer: Bibi.Pet - Toddlers Games - Colors and Shapes
apple-itunes:1316632530.description:
Are you ready to discover the magic world of Bibi.Pet?
The funny little animals that live there have particular shapes and speak their own special language: the Bibi’s language, which only children can understand.
Bibi.Pet are cute, friendly and scatterbrained, and can’t wait to play with all the family!
You can learn and have fun with them with colors, shapes, puzzles and logic games.
In this episode the Bibi.Pet are taken up with running a restaurant. You can help our friends to cook the dishes, mix the ingredients like a real chef, put the plates scattered around the kitchen in order and taste the restaurant’s specialties.
Will the little piggy manage to bake all the cakes? Or will the donkey manage to wash the dishes without breaking any? And what’s that crazy cat doing jumping on the tables? Your help is desperately needed in this magic restaurant. Come and play with us!
Features:
- Associate colors
- Learn shapes
- Use logic
- Complete puzzles
- Educational games for children over 2 years of age
- Lots of different games for learning while having fun
--- DESIGNED FOR LITTLE ONES --- 
- Absolutely no adverts 
- Designed to entertain children aged from 2 to 6, from little to big!
- Games with SIMPLE rules for children to play alone or with their parents. 
- Perfect for children at play school. 
- A host of entertaining sounds and interactive animation. 
- No need for reading skills, perfect also for pre-school or nursery children. 
- Characters created for boys and girls. 
--- SHAPES AND COLORS ---
Our shape and color puzzles are made for infants and toddlers. Children from 0-3 years can start to learn and perceive colors and basic geometric shapes, interacting simply and intuitively.
--- ASSOCIATIONS AND LOGIC ---
Logical associations and puzzles are one of the best ways for small boys and girls to learn while having fun. Our association games enable kids to start identifying differences and group elements by shape, colors and type of object.
--- TRANSPARENCY & SAFETY ---
Bibi.Pet takes your family's digital safety seriously. We are fully dedicated to protecting your children's data online by rigorously following the compliance standards set by COPPA (Children’s Online Privacy Protection Rule) and KidSAFE.
• Privacy policy: https://www.bibi.pet/privacy
• Terms of use: https://www.bibi.pet/terms_of_use
--- Bibi.Pet Who are we? --- 
We produce games for our children, and it is our passion. We produce tailor-made games, without invasive advertising by third parties. 
Some of our games have free trial versions, which means you can try them out first before purchases, supporting our team and enabling us to develop new games and keep all our apps up-to-date. 
We create a variety of games based on: colours and shapes, dressing up, dinosaur games for boys, games for girls, mini-games for smaller children and many other fun and educational games; you can try them all! 
Our thanks to all the families who show their trust in Bibi.Pet!

firefox-addons:3134378.description:
Biano Shopping Assistant shows the discount codes and deals of the online shop you are on, right when you need them.
• On a shop that Biano knows, a small card offers its current discount codes. One click copies the code and reloads the page through Biano, so you can paste it straight into the cart.
• The shop's other deals are listed below the codes.
• Closed the card? It stays hidden on that shop for a day, unless the shop gets a new code.
• Click the toolbar icon any time to see all offers of the shop.
Biano compares furniture and home décor from thousands of shops in 11 countries. The codes come from the shops and their newsletters. For a purchase through Biano, Biano may receive a commission from the shop; it costs you nothing.
